digest.component_or_area: Jira outbound comment sync, reconcile-bridge workflow, comment deduplication
propositions: The outbound comment sync re-posted duplicate comments to Jira every hourly pass due to an inert primary comment-id dedup map, leaving only a lossy body-membership fallback; 30 affected issues accumulated 30,011 duplicate bot-authored comments
REB-1861 reached Jira's hard 5000-comment cap at 79 distinct bodies held, blocking new comment sync attempts with COMMENTS_PER_ISSUE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error
The reconcile-bridge workflow was paused (disabled_manually) before this cleanup, fixing the duplicate set and preventing it from growing further
Phase 1 deleted 29,931 duplicates across 27 issues using marker detection (pre-strip ADF text render) and keep-oldest-per-distinct-normalized-body rule, verified by independent backup diff

836 truncation-suffix comments across 3 issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) lack the reconciler marker due to 32767-char truncation dropping the marker paragraph, and were deliberately not deleted pending separate operator decision
A marker-loss defect in the truncation logic defeats loop-breaker recognition for outbound comments exceeding the size limit
